In an OpenSearch cluster, dedicated coordinator nodes handle two key responsibilities.
• Request handling – These nodes receive incoming search requests and forward them to the
appropriate data nodes, which store the relevant data. They then consolidate the results from
multiple data nodes into a single global result set, which is returned to the client.
• Dashboards hosting – Coordinator nodes manage OpenSearch Dashboards, which relieves data
nodes from the additional burden of hosting OpenSearch Dashboards and handling related
traﬃc.
Dedicated coordinator nodes

In VPC domains, dedicated coordinator nodes are assigned Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) rather
than data nodes. This arrangement helps reduce the number of private IP addresses required for
VPCs, which improves network eﬃciency. Typically, dedicated coordinator nodes make up around
10% of the total data nodes.
